name: astro-ai
description: Run the A.S.T.R.O AI coding agent on your folder from VS Code: background and parallel agents in isolated copies, review, merge and undo. Uses the free models of your local A.S.T.R.O AI app.

commands.title: Ask the agent about the selection
Agents: follow, diff, merge, discard, undo

astro.serverUrl.description: A.S.T.R.O AI engine URL. Empty: find the desktop app's engine (127.0.0.1:47612, 47611) or a local server on 4173, and start it with `astro server start` if needed.

astro.token.description: Sign-in token, only for a server with accounts turned on (the desktop app does not need one).

enumDescriptions: Act alone (a checkpoint is saved for undo)
Read-only: inspect and write a plan

astro.isolate.description: Run single agents in an isolated copy (git worktree or copy) that you merge afterwards. Parallel agents are always isolated.

astro.review.description: A second model reviews the work at the end (one fix round).

astro.model.description: Preferred model id (see `astro models`). Empty: the best free coding model, with automatic fallback.

astro.project.description: Use this A.S.T.R.O AI project instead of opening the current folder (needed for a remote server).

astro.cliPath.description: Path to the `astro` terminal app, if it is not on your PATH.
